name: io.github.physics-star-cat/databutler-calendar
description: Calendar facts for 2026–2028 a model's training data cannot hold: public holidays for the UK (England & Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland), US federal, Germany (nationwide and all 16 Länder) and France (métropole, Alsace-Moselle) from the official lists, tax-year starts and ends for nine countries with the statute quoted, and daylight-saving switch dates with their statutory rule — a monthly snapshot with source URL and verification date on every answer.
